title: PEAfowl: Perception-Enhanced Multi-View Vision-Language-Action for Bimanual Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2601.17885v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bimanual manipulation in cluttered scenes requires policies that remain stable under occlusions, viewpoint changes and scene variations. Existing vision-language-action models often lack such robustness because (i) multi-view features are fused via view-agnostic token concatenation, yielding limited cross-view spatial representations, and (ii) language is injected as global conditioning, resulting in coarse instruction grounding. In this paper, we introduce PEAfowl, a perception-enhanced multi-view VLA policy for bimanual manipulation. For spatial perception, PEAfowl predicts per-token depth distributions, performs differentiable 3D lifting, and aggregates local cross-view neighbors to form geometrically grounded, cross-view aligned representations. translated_title: PEAfowl：面向双臂操作的多视图视觉-语言-动作感知增强策略
translated_abstract: 在杂乱场景中的双臂操作要求策略在遮挡、视角变化和场景变化下保持稳定性。现有的视觉-语言-动作模型通常缺乏这种鲁棒性，原因在于：(i) 多视图特征通过视图无关的标记拼接进行融合，导致跨视图空间表示有限；(ii) 语言以全局条件注入，导致指令接地粗糙。在本文中，我们介绍了PEAfowl，一种用于双臂操作的感知增强多视图VLA策略。在空间感知方面，PEAfowl预测每个标记的深度分布，进行可微的三维提升，并聚合局部跨视图邻居以形成几何接地、跨视图对齐的表示。在语言利用方面，我们提出用Perceiver风格的文本感知读取替代全局条件，作用于冻结的CLIP视觉特征，实现迭代证据累积。
tldr: 本文提出PEAfowl，一种通过预测深度分布和可微三维提升增强跨视图空间表示，并采用Perceiver式文本读取替代全局条件以实现精细指令接地的多视图视觉-语言-动作策略，显著提升了双臂操作在杂乱场景下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PEAfowl, a multi-view vision-language-action policy that enhances cross-view spatial representation via per-token depth prediction and differentiable 3D lifting, and replaces global language conditioning with Perceiver-style text-aware readout for fine-grained instruction grounding, improving bimanual manipulation robustness in cluttered scenes.
